**Job Description

**_Transaction Banking is changing fast, and the way customers connect with their bank is becoming more sophisticated. Danske Bank is bringing its Customer Implementation and Integration areas together under one unit, and we are looking for a leader who can create a shared direction, build a strong leadership team, and make complex customer journeys simpler and more consistent across five markets.

_**What You Will Be Doing

**You will lead a newly unified organisation spanning Denmark, Sweden, Norway, Finland and Lithuania, bringing together experienced leaders, specialist teams and distinct capabilities. Reporting directly to the Head of TxB Sales Enablement, you will work closely with colleagues across Sales, Product, Technology, IT and Tribe organisation to shape end-to-end customer experiences. Your role sits at the intersection of business, operations and technology, and the decisions you make will shape how corporate customers and financial institutions connect with Danske Bank.

More specifically, you will:

• Set the strategic direction and priorities across all five markets

• Build and develop a leadership team grounded in clarity, empowerment and accountability

• Connect Customer Implementation and Integration to create more seamless customer journeys

• Partner with IT and Tribe teams to shape customer-facing solutions and internal tooling

• Use client insights to inform implementation journeys, integration solutions and commercial priorities

• Encourage the responsible adoption of AI to simplify processes and build employee capabilities

**About You

**

• Solid experience leading organisations through other leaders

• Genuine commitment to developing people, teams and leadership cultures

• Ability to create direction across countries or complex organisational structures

• Skilled at translating strategy into clear priorities and tangible outcomes

• Strong customer and commercial orientation

• Comfortable at the intersection of business, operations and technology

• Able to bring structure and clarity to ambiguous, multi-stakeholder situations

You do not need to come from a traditional banking background. Experience from financial services, consulting, technology, transformation, customer implementation, integrations, APIs, cash management or similar environments is equally relevant and welcome.

**What We Offer You

**This is a rare opportunity to shape a newly formed organisation and leave a lasting mark on how Danske Bank delivers for its customers. You will work in a hybrid model, typically three to four days per week in the office, alongside talented colleagues across multiple markets. We invest in our leaders and offer genuine scope to grow, both in the role and across the wider organisation.

**Are you ready for the next step?

**If this sounds like the right move for you, we encourage you to apply. You are also welcome to reach out to Natasha Rajovic, Head of TxB Sales Enablement, at nkuz@danskebank.dk with any questions before applying.

Location: Aarhus or Copenhagen.

**We look forward to hearing from you!

****About Us

**Danske Bank is a Nordic bank with bridges to the world around us. For 150 years, we have supported people and businesses in releasing their potential. A career with us is an opportunity to join a community of 22,000 colleagues in a culture where we are committed to Teaming Up, Owning It and Being Open. Together, we are on a journey to transform Danske Bank into a better bank. For our customers, our employees and the societies around us.

Senior Supply Chain Solution Architect (D365 FO) M/F

Vacancy description

Senior Supply Chain Solution Architect (D365 FO) M/F

Shape and integrate the future Supply Chain platform of a growing global company with Microsoft Dynamics 365 FO at its core.

Highlights of the offer

• Job offer expiration: 02/12/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark, Ikast

You will work at the intersection of Supply Chain, technology and M&A, helping define how new businesses are assessed, integrated and transitioned towards scalable global solutions.

Your impact:

You will play a key role in shaping the architecture for the Supply Chain domain, with a strong focus on D365 Supply Chain Management and the wider Supply Chain application landscape.

You will:

• Shape the architecture across D365 and the surrounding Supply Chain ecosystem.

• Lead Supply Chain architecture for M&A integrations, from assessment and integration planning through implementation.

• Define how acquired applications, data and integrations transition towards our strategic platforms.

• Drive the evolution and roadmap of D365 SCM across planning, procurement, manufacturing, warehousing and logistics.

• Define integrations across D365, MES, PLM, data platforms and other Supply Chain solutions.

• Drive standardisation and scalable solution design across the global landscape.

• Collaborate with business stakeholders, architects and implementation partners across regions and functions.

Our requirements

• Strong experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 F&O / Supply Chain Management.

• Experience as a Solution Architect or Senior Functional Architect.

• Deep understanding of Supply Chain and manufacturing processes.

• Experience with ERP transformations and complex enterprise integrations.

• Experience with M&A integration, ERP consolidation or acquired businesses is an advantage.

• Strong stakeholder management and ability to combine strategic thinking with hands-on solution design.

Experience with integration, MES, PLM, Power Platform, IoT, or M&A is an advantage.

We offer

By joining KK Group, you will be part of a culture where diversity is embraced, every nationality is respected, and trust and collaboration across perspectives drives our success. Across our global organisation, we offer a wide range of job opportunities spanning office-based roles, production facilities, and onsite positions worldwide. Whether you’re interested in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or support functions, you’ll find opportunities at KK Group to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact.

Potential Benefits (Depending on Role)

Further information

If the above matches your field of interest and your qualifications, please send your application and resume as soon as possible. Interviews are held on an ongoing basis.

For further information, please contact:

Henrik Nørgaard Veng   henve@kkgroup.com

About KK Group

KK Group is a global technology partner delivering power, controls, cooling, monitoring and service solutions for renewable energy and energy-intensive industries.

With more than 45 years of experience in the wind industry and technologies installed in over 120,000 turbines worldwide, KK Group provides critical electro-mechanical systems that enable electrification, improve energy efficiency, and optimise the lifetime performance of industrial assets.

The company’s capabilities span the full value chain - from development and manufacturing to service and digital solutions - supporting customers across the entire lifecycle of their platforms. Backed by its long-term owner, A.P. Moller Holding, KK Group is expanding beyond wind into selected energy-intensive industries including hydrogen, mining, rail and defence.

Today, KK Group employs more than 3,700 people across 10+ countries and is building a more diversified, resilient and global business - Powering Change towards a more sustainable tomorrow.

Visit www.kkgroup.com to learn more about our company and career opportunities.

Senior D365 F&O Business/Functional Consultant

• Permanent contract

• Full-time

• At least 5 years of experience (Senior level)

• Bachelor degree

• IT

Mission

**Do you want to help shape the future of supply chain operations at the world’s leading maritime supplier of provisions and stores?**Do you have extensive knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations and a deep understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes, from Sales and Procurement to Warehouse and Logistics? Are you ready to take the lead in shaping and optimizing our global supply chain processes, turning business requirements into effective D365 F&O solutions?

If you are a business-oriented D365 F&O specialist who enjoys engaging with stakeholders, asking the right questions and constructively challenging existing ways of working, this could be the opportunity for you.

Become part of our ERP team in Nørresundby, DenmarkWith reference to our Team Lead, Kim Faarbæk, you will become part of our ERP team, working closely with business stakeholders and IT colleagues across our international organization.

As a Senior D365 F&O Business/Functional Consultant, your primary focus will be the full Supply Chain area in Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, covering order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, warehousing, inventory and logistics. You will be involved throughout the entire project lifecycle, from requirements gathering and solution design to testing, training, go-live and post-production support.

Senior D365 F&O Business/Functional Consultant with a focus on Supply Chain ManagementYou will play a key role in shaping and implementing our global D365 F&O solution. Working closely with business stakeholders, developers and ERP specialists, you will translate business requirements into functional designs and sustainable system solutions, while sharing best practices and driving process improvements.

You will also be involved in our transition from Microsoft Dynamics AX 2012 to D365 F&O, giving you the opportunity to influence solution design and shape future global processes across Sales, Procurement, Warehouse and Logistics. Through workshops and stakeholder collaboration, you will help deliver harmonized solutions that support our future growth and operational efficiency.

**

More specifically, your key responsibilities will be to:**

• Lead the configuration and implementation of core D365 F&O Supply Chain modules, including Sales, Procurement, Inventory, Warehouse and Transportation Management.

• Configure and optimize end-to-end supply chain processes across order-to-cash, procure-to-pay, warehousing, inventory and logistics.

• Advise on supply chain process improvements, with a focus on standard D365 functionality, inventory optimization and process harmonization.

• Gather, analyse and document business requirements, translating them into functional designs, user stories, acceptance criteria and system configurations.

• Develop functional design documentation for customizations, integrations, reports and system enhancements.

• Plan and execute testing activities, including system integration testing (SIT), user acceptance testing (UAT) and data validation.

• Collaborate with developers, architects and ERP specialists on integrations, customizations, data migration from AX 2012 and issue resolution.

• Lead workshops and training sessions, support implementation and user adoption, and share D365 F&O best practices to drive continuous improvement across the organization.

Profile

**Qualifications & requirements

**You bring extensive knowledge of Microsoft Dynamics 365 Finance & Operations, supported by several years of hands-on implementation experience. You have a strong understanding of end-to-end supply chain processes across Sales, Procurement, Inventory, Warehouse and Logistics. You are comfortable engaging with stakeholders at all levels, constructively challenging requirements and translating business needs into clear, functional solutions.

Furthermore, we expect that you have:

• 3+ years of experience as a functional consultant implementing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management (D365 F&O).

• Extensive functional knowledge of core D365 F&O modules, including Sales, Procurement, Inventory, Warehouse and Transportation Management.

• Proven experience with end-to-end order-to-cash and procure-to-pay processes, as well as inbound, outbound, warehousing and inventory processes.

• Experience with advanced Supply Chain modules such as Master Planning, Production Control, or Quality Management.

• Experience with requirements gathering, process mapping, functional design, configuration, testing and implementation.

• Experience with customizations, integrations, data entities, workflows, security roles and data migration.

• Strong stakeholder management and communication skills in English, with experience leading workshops and collaborating across functions and cultures.

• A structured and delivery-focused approach, with attention to quality, documentation and agreed deadlines.

**

It is an advantage if you have:**

• Experience in distribution, logistics, manufacturing or other asset-driven industries.

• Microsoft Certified: Dynamics 365 Supply Chain Management Functional Consultant Associate certification.

• Experience with the Power Platform, including Power BI, Power Automate and Power Apps.

• Experience with EDI, system integrations or warehouse automation solutions.

• A relevant bachelor's degree, e.g. in Supply Chain Management, Business or IT.

**

Personality matters

**You are curious, analytical and collaborative, with a natural ability to engage with people and build strong relationships across the business and IT. You enjoy asking the right questions, challenging existing processes and finding practical solutions to complex business needs. You communicate clearly, take ownership and thrive in an international environment where knowledge-sharing, teamwork and continuous improvement are key.

**

We offer more than just a job

**We wish to be the best at what we do, and everything we do is based on our values of “Winning Attitude, Customer Orientation, and Getting it Done”. We offer flexible working hours and numerous employee benefits, counting a healthy canteen, take-away, free fruit, and fitness facilities. Wrist supports local elite sports, offering tickets to home games. You can expect free parking and access to Clever EV charging stations. Moreover, we have an active employee association that invites us all to play paddle, badminton, board games etc. and to join the yearly DHL relay race.

**

Ready to apply?

**Please send us your application and CV via the “Apply” button no later than 30. November 2026. We want to fill the position as soon as possible and will continuously invite candidates for interviews, so do not hesitate to submit your application and CV.

If you have questions or want to know more about the team, please reach out to Team Lead, Kim Faarbæk, at kifa@wrist.com or by phone on +45 2097 3050

**

At Wrist, we are committed to cultivating a culture of belonging where every individual feels seen, valued, and respected

**As a global company, we aim to reflect the communities we are part of, believing that our strength comes from diverse perspectives, experiences, and the unique contributions each person offers. We welcome applications from all qualified candidates, and we are dedicated to maintaining a recruitment process that is inclusive, fair, and respectful. By fostering a supportive workplace culture rooted in belonging, we lay the foundation for meaningful collaboration and shared success.

**

About Wrist

**Wrist is the world’s leading ship and offshore supplier of marine provisions and stores with a market share of approximately 12%. We are the only provisions and stores marine supplier with a global network of supply operations. We also offer services within owners’ goods and spare parts logistics, combining provisions and stores deliveries directly to the vessels. With the launch of the digital marketplace, Source2Sea, Wrist is leading the digital transformation of the marine supply industry. All year round, we offer 24/7 global online sourcing and logistics, providing data transparency, automation, and convenience to our customers. We continuously work on reducing our climate impact while at the same time proactively addressing our customers’ growing demand and need for responsible solutions and services. From more than 30 locations worldwide, in all major shipping locations, 1,800 Wrist employees take pride in making it easy for our customers to order and receive marine supplies and services.

jobs.occupation: Research Assistants in Medical Robotics (Navigation & Control)
jobs.description:
The Department of Computer Science invites applications for one-year research assistant positions focused on developing innovative robot control and navigation techniques using simulation-based learning for medical robotic endoscope devices.

  Project Background
 This project addresses two critical challenges in the field of medical robotics to improve patient care through advanced simulation and control:

   	
• Image-Based Navigation: Creating reward functions for scoring navigation policies for medical robotic devices moving inside the human body, relying solely on image information and accounting for environment changes through interaction models. 	
• Soft Robot Control: Developing learning-based methods to control a soft robot endoscope via high-level navigation policies to perform clinical procedures inside the human body, including quality assessment of these methods during in-vivo interventions.   The successful candidates will join a multidisciplinary and collaborative team renowned for cutting-edge research in medical imaging and simulation technologies, operating within a global network across France, Germany, and Spain.

  Roles and Responsibilities
 The successful candidates will play a central role in the project’s technical and scientific success. While the level of autonomy will vary by position, both roles will share the following core responsibilities:

   	
• Technical Development & Implementation: Designing and implementing machine learning methods for motion planning and control. This includes integrating simulation-based learning frameworks and demonstrating the resulting systems on real robotic hardware and soft robot endoscopes. 	
• Research & Scientific Contribution: Contributing to the project’s core objectives by producing impactful research outputs. This includes writing high-quality papers for peer-reviewed journals and presenting findings at international conferences. 	
• Collaboration & Knowledge Exchange: Facilitating collaborations with industrial partners and academic collaborators to ensure that the developed methodologies are meaningful and translatable to real-world clinical practice. 	
• Professional Growth & Mentorship: Engaging in a high-growth research environment. The positions can be extendable and towards a PhD depending on the future funding status. The project has a trackrecord of landing members in top PhD program and faculty positions. 	
• Interdisciplinary Integration: Actively participating in team discussions and workshops to integrate expertise across medical imaging, physics simulation, and robotics control.   Profile
 We are looking for a highly motivated and enthusiastic scientist with the following competencies and experience:

  Essential experience and skills

   	
• MSc in the fields mentioned above. 	
• You have a strong foundation and track record in robotics simulation, robot control, computer vision and/or machine learning for physical systems. 	
• You are highgly experienced in numerical optimization algorithms, preferably applied to motion planning or reinforcement learning. Hands-on experience on real robots especially soft robot systems is a plus. 	
• Proficient scientific computing and programming (C++/Python) and experience with libraries such as PyTorch, JAX, Warp, Taichi, or ROS. 	
• Excellent communication skills and a high level of motivation to work in a multidisciplinary, international research environment.   Desireable experience and skills

   	
• Experience in publishing peer-reviewed research in top-tier robotics or AI venues. 	
• Familiarity with physics simulation such as MuJoCo, Isaac Sim, Newton Physics, SOFA etc.   Terms of employment
 The average weekly working hours are 37 hours per week.

  The position is a fixed-term position limited to a period of 1 year. The starting date is 15 February or after agreement

  Salary, pension and other conditions of employment are set in accordance with the Agreement between the Ministry of Taxation and AC (Danish Confederation of Professional Associations) or other relevant organisation.

  Foreign and Danish applicants may be eligible for tax reductions, if they hold a PhD degree and have not lived in Denmark the last 10 years.

  The position is covered by the Job Structure for Academic Staff at Universities 2025. 

  Questions
 Further information on the Department is linked at http://www.science.ku.dk/english/about-the-faculty/organisation/. Inquiries about the positions can be made to kenny@di.ku.dk and hayi@di.ku.dk.

  Application procedure

   	
• Your online application must be submitted in English by clicking ‘Apply now’ below. Furthermore, your application must include the following documents/attachments – all in PDF format 	
• Motivated letter of application (max. one page). 	
• CV incl. education, work/research experience, language skills and other skills relevant for the position. 	
• A certified/signed copy of a Master of Science certificate. 	
• List of publications.   Deadline for applications: 30 November 2026, 23:59 GMT +1.
 We reserve the right not to consider material received after the deadline, and not to consider applications that do not live up to the abovementioned requirements.

  The further process 
 After the expiry of the deadline for applications, the authorized recruitment manager selects applicants for assessment on the advice of the hiring committee. All applicants are then immediately notified whether their application has been passed for assessment by an unbiased assessor. Once the assessment work has been completed each applicant has the opportunity to comment on the part of the assessment that relates to the applicant him/herself.

  You can read about the recruitment process at http://employment.ku.dk/faculty/recruitment-process/

  The applicant will be assessed according to the Ministerial Order no. 242 of 13 March 2012 on the Appointment of Academic Staff at Universities.

   

  The University wishes our staff to reflect the diversity of society and thus welcomes applications from all qualified candidates regardless of personal background.

Do you want to help shape the future of EV charging from the finance side? We are looking for an experienced, hands-on Head of Accounting to lead the accounting function at Spirii, a fast-growing e-mobility scale-up and part of the Edenred Group. The role ensures reliable financial records, a disciplined close and reporting process, statutory and VAT compliance, effective controls and a strong team. The business has complex accounting and international VAT requirements, and its processes, systems and controls continue to evolve as it scales.

1. Accounting operations, month-end close and Group reporting

• Lead day-to-day accounting operations, including general ledger, Accounts Payable, bank accounting, fixed assets, accruals, prepayments, provisions and intercompany accounting, as applicable.

• Own monthly and annual close, ensuring accurate and timely transaction recording, cut-off, reconciliations, supporting documentation and resolution of outstanding items.

• Ensure Balance Sheet integrity and oversee local statutory financial statements under Danish accounting requirements; lead the external audit process and respond to audit requests.

• Prepare and submit the Balance Sheet reporting package to Group under IFRS every two months; coordinate queries with Group Finance and meet Group deadlines.

• Set up, maintain and enhance the ERP system with support of the ERP expert to ensure effective accounting and to enable relevant data for FP&A and the business.

2. Internal controls, risk management and audit remediation

• Own the design, documentation, implementation and monitoring of controls across accounting and VAT processes, including segregation of duties, approval workflows, access rights and reconciliations.

• Identify control weaknesses, financial risks and recurring process failures; maintain clear procedures and evidence of control execution.

• Follow up findings from internal and external audits, control reviews and risk assessments; agree owners, actions and deadlines with process owners, monitor completion and escalate significant or overdue issues to the CFO.

• The role is responsible for the remediation of finance findings from internal audits, but not for the overall internal audit process.

3. VAT and statutory compliance

• Oversee VAT accounting, returns, reconciliations and compliance in Denmark and other relevant jurisdictions, including international registrations and correct treatment of domestic and cross-border transactions.

• Ensure timely statutory filings for corporation tax, transfer pricing, tax payments, Danmarks Statistik declarations and other required legal registrations; coordinate with external tax advisers and local representatives as needed.

• Maintain supporting documentation and a robust VAT control framework; identify and address compliance risks, recurring errors and potential exposures.

4. Cash management

• Monitor and report actual cash balances weekly and maintain a rolling short-term cash outlook covering expected receipts and payments. Explain material variances and flag potential cash shortfalls or significant payment commitments.

5. Team leadership, stakeholder management and continuous improvement

• Lead, organise and develop a team of 4, setting clear responsibilities and objectives, managing workload and performance, and building technical capabilities.

• Partner with FP&A to ensure reliable accounting actuals and supporting information; coordinate with Group Finance on accounting policies and reporting requirements.

• Partner with the rest of our finance team to support timely and accurate billing and VAT compliance.

• Work with business stakeholders and IT to improve accounting processes, documentation, systems, automation, data quality and integrations; reduce manual work, errors and bottlenecks, and ensure changes are appropriately tested and controlled.

• Build effective relationships across Finance and the wider business, resolving issues that affect accounting, reporting and compliance.

How the role fits in Finance

You will own accounting operations, local statutory accounting, VAT compliance, internal controls, follow-up on audit findings and the Balance Sheet reporting to Group. You will work closely with FP&A, who own monthly P&L reporting, budgeting and forecasting, and with our billing team, who own billing calculations and controls.

Candidate profile

• 10+ years of relevant experience in accounting, finance operations or financial control, including senior accounting leadership.

• Experience from an international group environment is required.

• Experience from EV or e-mobility, fintech or transaction-based businesses is a strong plus.

• Degree in Accounting, Finance, Auditing or a related field; professional accounting qualifications are an advantage.

• Strong knowledge of accounting, month-end close, Balance Sheet reconciliations, statutory accounting, financial controls and international VAT.

• Knowledge of Danish GAAP (Årsregnskabsloven) and IFRS.

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Business Central ERP is required.

• Fluent or native Danish and professional fluency in English are required.

• Proven ability to lead and develop a team, improve finance processes and controls, and work effectively with Finance, Group and business stakeholders; structured, analytical and hands-on.

What success looks like

A reliable and timely close; accurate Balance Sheet reconciliations and on-time Group submissions; effective controls and prompt remediation of findings; robust VAT and statutory compliance; clear weekly cash visibility; and a capable, accountable team delivering continuous improvement.

Benefits

It is important for us to create a healthy, diverse, fun, and creative working environment, so besides all the basic benefits, we also focus a lot on social activities, flexible working hours and a good work life balance.

• Flexible Work Environment: Enjoy a collaborative, inclusive, and open workplace designed to fit your needs and support work-life balance.

• Competitive Package: A competitive salary, an 11% company pension plan, and a comprehensive benefits package.

• Time to Recharge: Benefit from 32 paid vacation days and paid parental leave to focus on what matters most.

• Career Growth: Access professional development opportunities and grow your career in a high-impact, high-growth industry.

• Stay Energized: Enjoy excellent coffee, tea, free snacks, and subsidized lunches at the office.

• Stay Active: Use our Spirii Gym or join a Spirii Run with colleagues.

• Make an Impact: Be part of a team driving the future of sustainable energy while working on meaningful projects.

About Spirii – Who We Are

Spirii is a full-service e-mobility provider which offers hardware and software charging solutions to companies in the private and the public sector. Spirii was founded seven years ago as a company. Nevertheless, the people in Spirii have extensive experience working with electric cars and charging, as well as the development of future transport- and energy systems.

Spirii is an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from candidates of all backgrounds and experiences. Spirii strives to create an inclusive and diverse workplace, and we encourage all qualified applicants to apply regardless of age, gender, race, sexual/religious orientation, or disability.

Are you passionate about leading high-performing teams and delivering business-critical technology solutions? BEC Financial Technologies is looking for a Development Manager to join our Document Lifecycle Management team at our office in Roskilde.

Our team develops, maintains, and operates core document management and archiving platforms used by Danish banks. These solutions support essential banking processes and enable secure, compliant, and reliable document handling throughout the document lifecycle.

As Development Manager, you will lead a distributed team of specialists based in Denmark and Poland and manage strategic vendor relationships. Reporting to the Head of Document Lifecycle Management, you will drive delivery, ensure operational stability, and support the continued evolution of critical platforms that operate around the clock, every day of the year.

Working closely with business stakeholders, architects, vendors, and other technology teams, you will play a key role in shaping the future of document lifecycle management at BEC.

At BEC, we prefer to collaborate often in the office, while also offering the opportunity to work remotely on average up to 1 day per week.

Primary tasks and responsibilities:

• Be accountable for the team’s contribution to the domain roadmap and delivery against agreed objectives.

• Drive the implementation and continuous improvement of technical solutions that create value for our customers and BEC.

• Define and maintain the delivery strategy and team setup required to deliver the team backlog effectively.

• Lead the performance of people, processes, vendors, and technology, with clear roles, responsibilities, and processes across the value chain.

• Ensure that development complies with BEC’s architectural principles, engineering standards, and security requirements.

• Own the maintenance and operation of the systems and platforms within the team, including incident and problem management, service continuity, system lifecycle management, and technical debt.

• Ensure operational excellence through proactive management of audit and compliance requirements, patching, technical vulnerabilities, exceptions, and lifecycle risks.

• Ensure that solutions comply with relevant regulatory, information security, data protection, and audit requirements.

• Secure the budget, resources, approvals, competencies, and organizational support required for successful delivery.

• Build trusted relationships with key stakeholders, gather feedback, and translate business needs into clear priorities.

To succeed, you will have:

• A relevant higher education, preferably within IT, finance, business, or a related field, combined with several years of experience in a similar leadership role.

• Proven leadership experience managing cross-functional and multicultural teams, preferably in mission-critical IT environments.

• A strong ability to set direction, develop people, create engagement, and establish clear accountability.

jobs.occupation: Product Marketing Manager - B2B Software for Manufacturers
jobs.description:
Location: Central Copenhagen — primarily in office

Reports to: Co-founder & CEO

Language: English

Highlights:

• Fast-growing B2B software platform with established global reach is looking for our first marketing hire.

• We have a broad, multi-product offering for a narrow industry, and we don't fit into a single existing "category box" as defined today -- giving you a meaty challenge to work with.

• We have large customers and touch a lot of users (as a platform for managing global supply-chains), so your work will be "heard around the world"

• We are a small, efficient, get-stuff-done team. Looking for someone who things that's the way to go.

About Supplios

Manufacturers live or die by their supply base. Sourcing the wrong supplier, onboarding one slowly, failing to qualify one properly or losing track of a non-conformance can stop a production line and cost millions. Yet most manufacturers still run these relationships across email chains, spreadsheets and shared drives.

Supplios is a supplier collaboration platform for manufacturers in automotive and industrial sectors. We cover the full supplier relationship: sourcing, onboarding, qualification, day-to-day collaboration, compliance and supplier quality — with a modern cloud based platform that is easy for manufacturers to implement and operate. It is built specifically for the way automotive and industrial manufacturers actually work.

We are headquartered in central Copenhagen and already serve customers globally in our vertical, including some of the most demanding names in automotive. We have grown to this point almost entirely on product strength, domain credibility and word of mouth. We have done very little marketing.

That is where you come in.

The role

This is our first marketing hire.

You will own positioning, messaging and sales enablement for a platform that already has real customers, real reference stories and real competitive wins — but no one whose job it is to articulate any of it. There is no existing playbook to inherit, no legacy brand guidelines to work around, and no committee to navigate. There is a large amount of low-hanging fruit and a clear runway to make a visible commercial impact within your first few months.

You will work directly and closely with our co-founder and CEO, who continues to run product. He knows the product and the domain deeply; what he needs is a strong product marketing partner to turn that into sharp positioning, messaging that lands with procurement, quality and operations buyers, and material that makes the sales conversation easier.

This is a hands-on, execution-focused role. You will be writing the copy, building the deck and updating the website — not briefing an agency to do it.

We work together from our office in central Copenhagen. This is primarily an in-office role: at this stage, and in this role in particular, the close working relationship with management & sales is much easier to build in person.

What you will do

• Own positioning and messaging for the Supplios platform and its individual modules, and make it consistent across every touchpoint

• Translate technical capability into buyer-relevant value for distinct personas — sourcing and procurement leads, supplier quality engineers, quality directors, supply chain and operations management

• Build the sales enablement layer: pitch decks, one-pagers, battlecards, demo narratives, proposal content and objection handling

• Run competitive and market intelligence, and keep the team honest about where we genuinely win and where we do not

• Plan and execute go-to-market for new modules and major releases, in step with the product roadmap

• Develop customer proof — case studies, reference stories and use cases — from an installed base that has plenty to say

• Rebuild our website messaging and product pages so they reflect what we actually do and who we do it for

• Feed structured market and customer insight back into product decisions

What we are looking for

Essential

• Proven product marketing experience in B2B or enterprise software, with responsibility for positioning, messaging and sales enablement

• A demonstrable track record of translating complex, technical products into clear commercial value propositions

• Excellent written English

• Comfort operating without a marketing team, an established playbook or a large budget — you scope the work, then do it

• The temperament for a small, senior, fast-moving company: high ownership, low ceremony

Nice to have

• Domain knowledge in automotive, industrial manufacturing or supply chain. Genuinely a plus, not a requirement. We can teach the domain to the right marketer; we cannot teach product marketing to a domain expert.

• Experience marketing to enterprise buyers with long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles

• Experience as an early marketing hire at a growing B2B software company

Language

• English is the only important language for this position — we work in English, and so do our customers. Danish language skills are not required.

Why this role is worth your time

• First marketing hire, not the fifth. You define how this company talks about itself.

• A product that already works. Real global customers in a demanding vertical, and reference stories waiting to be told.

• Work directly with the CEO/founders. No layers between you and the decisions.

• Visible impact. In a company that has barely marketed, good product marketing shows up in the pipeline quickly.

How to apply

Send your CV and a short note on why this role interests you to team@supplios.com. Work examples will help.

Apply by email

Send an email to team@supplios.com

Please include your CV / resume, and a brief note about why you're interested in the position.

Thanks!

jobs.occupation: PhD scholarship in Predictive Human Digital Twins for Human-Centred Systems Engineering – DTU Construct
jobs.description:
Are you interested in human-centred engineering at the intersection of biomechanics, artificial intelligence, and systems engineering, and want to build a strong methodological profile, this PhD position offers a unique opportunity – including the chance to help shape a new research group from the start.

At DTU Construct, you will develop methods that turn generic musculoskeletal models into personalised Human Digital Twins – based on sparse wearable sensor data instead of costly laboratory measurements or medical imaging – and assess how reliably they predict how a person moves and interacts with technical systems such as collaborative robots or assistive devices. The project is part of building up a new research group in Human-Centred Design within the Human-Centred Systems Engineering activities at DTU Construct. As part of the DTU PhD programme, you will follow PhD-level courses and contribute to teaching.

Responsibilities and qualifications
Your overall purpose will be to develop and validate methods for personalising biomechanical Human Digital Twins from sparse sensor data, combining physics-based and data-driven approaches and quantifying the gap between simulation and reality (sim2real).

Your primary tasks will be to:

• Develop methods for personalising musculoskeletal models from sparse multimodal sensor data.
• Combine physics-based and data-driven approaches for model calibration and prediction.
• Quantify and reduce the sim2real gap of Human Digital Twins.
• Plan and carry out experimental studies with human participants.
• Implement your methods in open, reusable software.
• Publish your results and collaborate with researchers at DTU and international partners.
We are looking for a motivated candidate with:

• An MSc in Biomedical or Mechanical Engineering, Robotics, Computer Science, Applied Mathematics, Engineering Design, or a related field.
• Solid programming skills (e.g. Python, MATLAB, C++).
• A background in simulation, optimisation, machine learning, sensor processing, or parameter estimation.
• A strong interest in computational modelling of humans and human-technology systems.
• Good communication skills in English and the ability to work both independently and in a team.
• Experience with musculoskeletal modelling (e.g. OpenSim, AnyBody, SCONE), motion analysis, or wearable sensing is an advantage.
• We do not expect you to master all of these areas – a solid foundation and the motivation to grow into the field matter most.
You must have a two-year master's degree (120 ECTS points) or a similar degree with an academic level equivalent to a two-year master's degree.

Approval and Enrolment 
The scholarship for the PhD degree is subject to academic approval, and the candidate will be enrolled in one of the general degree programmes at DTU. For information about our enrolment requirements and the general planning of the PhD study programme, please see DTU's rules for the PhD education. 

Assessment
The assessment of the applicants will be made by Jörg Miehling.

We offer
DTU is a leading technical university globally recognized for the excellence of its research, education, innovation and scientific advice. We offer a rewarding and challenging job in an international environment. We strive for academic excellence in an environment characterized by collegial respect and academic freedom tempered by responsibility.

Salary and appointment terms
The appointment will be based on the collective agreement with the Danish Confederation of Professional Associations. Please see DTU’s salary structure for scientific staff: www.inside.dtu.dk/en/human-resources/during-employment/salary/salary-structures.

The period of employment is 3 years. Starting date is 1 March 2027 (or according to mutual agreement). The position is a full-time position.

You can read more about career paths at DTU here.

Further information
Further information may be obtained from Jörg Miehling, jormi@dtu.dk (please mention “PhD Position Inquiry” in your email subject).

You can read more about Department of Civil and Mechanical Engineering at www.construct.dtu.dk and the Section at www.construct.dtu.dk/sections/engineering-design-and-manufacturing-systems.

If you are applying from abroad, you may find useful information on working in Denmark and at DTU at DTU – Moving to Denmark. Furthermore, you have the option of joining our monthly free seminar “PhD relocation to Denmark and startup “Zoom” seminar” for all questions regarding the practical matters of moving to Denmark and working as a PhD at DTU. 

Application procedure 
Your complete online application must be submitted no later than 2 December 2026 (23:59 Danish time). Applications must be submitted as one PDF file containing all materials to be given consideration. To apply, please open the link "Apply now", fill out the online application form, and attach all your materials in English in one PDF file. The file must include:

• A letter motivating the application (cover letter)
• Curriculum vitae 
• Grade transcripts and BSc/MSc diploma (in English) including official description of grading scale
• A copy of your BSc thesis (in pdf)
• A copy of your MSc thesis (in pdf)
• A copy of your scientific articles (if any) published so far (in pdf)
You may apply prior to obtaining your master's degree but cannot begin before having received it. 

Applications received after the deadline will not be considered.

All interested candidates irrespective of age, gender, disability, race, religion or ethnic background are encouraged to apply. As DTU works with research in critical technology, which is subject to special rules for security and export control, open-source background checks may be conducted on qualified candidates for the position.

DTU Civil and Mechanical Engineering develops and utilises science and technical knowledge for the benefit of society and the sustainable development. We undertake research, education, innovation, and scientific advice of the highest quality within building design and processes, building construction and safety, building energy and technical services, solid mechanics, fluid mechanics, coastal and maritime engineering, materials technology, manufacturing engineering, engineering systems design, design for sustainability, and thermal energy.

The Section of Engineering Design and Manufacturing Systems (EDM) advances the design of intelligent, resilient, and sustainable products and manufacturing systems, integrating systems engineering, modular architectures, robust and bio-inspired design, and AI-enabled engineering.

DTU – For the benefit of society since 1829
DTU is one of Europe's leading elite technical universities. Through research and education at an international top level, we create solutions to the major societal challenges of our time and help secure Europe's global leadership in sustainable technological development. Since Hans Christian Ørsted founded DTU almost 200 years ago, our mission has remained the same: We develop and create value through the natural and technical sciences for the benefit of society. DTU has 13,800 students, 1,600 PhD students, and 6,500 employees. We work in an international environment and have an inclusive, stimulating, and informal work culture. DTU has campuses in all parts of Denmark and in Greenland and collaborates with the best universities around the world.

Do you have experience in managing complex operations contracts and commercial risk across countries? Do you enjoy building something into the next level?

We are looking for a Senior Contract and Warranty Manager to take end-to-end ownership of operations contracts across Eurowind Energy's global wind, solar and BESS portfolio.

Who we are

Eurowind Energy is a global and leading developer, owner and operator of energy parks. Based in Denmark, we operate in 16 countries around Europe and in the USA, and we are continuously growing our project portfolio. We believe in a future of renewable energy, and we have an ambitious plan of becoming the next generation's "Power Major". Based on a full value chain from greenfield project development to energy trading, more than 700 team members are dedicated to creating a greener future fueled with nothing but renewable energy!

We are looking for an experienced Senior Contract and Warranty Manager to join our Global Operations team. Based at our Operations office in Hobro, you will be the contract and warranty specialist for our global asset portfolio, supporting colleagues and managers across countries and functions.

Your role

As Senior Contract and Warranty Manager, you will take ownership of key commercial agreements, claims and warranty matters across Eurowind Energy's global asset portfolio. You will work closely with Asset Management, Operations, Finance, Legal and local teams to ensure that our contractual rights are understood, protected and actively used. The role combines hands-on contract management with a strong focus on risk, value creation and standardization across markets.

• Own contract management for operations contracts, including service and O&M agreements, warranty and performance guarantees, grid connection and curtailment compensation, insurance, land lease and supplier agreements

• Lead negotiation, drafting and execution of contracts so they meet both legal and commercial requirements

• Identify, assess and mitigate commercial and legal risk across the contract portfolio

• Manage claims and warranty follow-up, making sure issues are tracked, escalated and resolved in line with contractual terms

• Build global contract templates, playbooks and governance processes that work consistently across countries

• Monitor contract performance and compliance, flagging risks and improvement opportunities

• Be the go-to contact for the country teams and the wider operations organisation on contract questions and disputes

You will work with the country operations teams, Strategic Commercial Management (which owns PPAs, power trading and balancing contracts), Technical Operations, Investor Administration, SCADA Operations, Legal, Finance, and suppliers and service providers. Your role is to strengthen the countries' ability to manage contracts locally, not to add another layer of bureaucracy.

What we offer

You will join Global Operations at a time where we are transforming how we manage and operate our global asset portfolio. You will get a broad international scope, close collaboration across functions and countries, and the opportunity to work with complex commercial and operational challenges. We offer a high level of autonomy, a strong professional environment and the opportunity to make a visible impact on how Eurowind operates.

• A newly created role where you set the structures and ways of working

• The chance to make a real impact on how we improve and operate our commercial mindset

• Ownership, trust and room to shape your own area

• A global role with some travel, in an international and energetic environment

• A workplace in Hobro, alongside our operations colleagues

You will join a newly established team and report to Louise Guldager Thomsen, Head of Global Commercial Management. Louise is a collaborative and pragmatic leader who builds strong relationships, creates alignment across functions and empowers people to take ownership. She combines a deep understanding of the organisation with a practical focus on execution and a global perspective.

Required competencies and skills

You have solid experience with contract management, commercial agreements, warranties and/or claims, ideally from the energy, infrastructure, construction or other asset-intensive industries. You are comfortable navigating complex contractual matters and working across technical, commercial and legal topics. You combine strong analytical and negotiation skills with a pragmatic approach and the ability to turn contractual knowledge into action and business value.

• Significant experience in contract management within energy, infrastructure, renewables or another asset-intensive industry

• A proven record of leading complex contract negotiations end-to-end, including service and O&M, warranty, grid/curtailment, insurance and supplier contracts

• Solid understanding of commercial and legal risk management, with experience building or applying compliance frameworks

• Relevant legal, commercial or technical education (for example law, business or engineering), or equivalent hands-on experience

• International experience and comfort working across countries and cultures

• Enjoys building something new and setting up structures from scratch

• Works autonomously across a global organisation and values being part of a team

• Structured and detail-oriented, yet pragmatic about getting things done without unnecessary process

• Communicates clearly and directly, holding suppliers and internal stakeholders accountable while working with respect

Please note that this role requires a clean criminal record.

Developing, operating and managing wind and solar parks is not just pure business for us. It is a way to view the world. And with this worldview comes a genuine ambition to be one of the leading developers in Europe. Because creating a future run entirely on green energy matters to us.
